name: team_stop
unavailable: The person allows one agent in this chat: there is no team. Do the work yourself.
description: Stop a subagent, and the subagents under it, where they are: their work stops and they end, which makes room for others. Only you, the main agent, stop subagents; `all` stops every one. Nothing they had not reported comes back — ask for a report with team_send first, or read their findings with team_findings.
